task: Client kick-off, in person. The project manager asks for a five-second intro from everyone. Say your name, role and company.
say: Let's go round the table and do quick intros.
zh: 客户项目启动会，面对面。项目经理请每人做一个五秒钟的自我介绍。说出你的名字、职位和公司。对方说：我们轮流快速介绍一下自己吧。
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Nice to meet you all.

task: A Teams call with a client, cameras on. The host calls on you next. Say hello, your name and your company in one or two sentences.
say: Okay, who have we got next?
zh: 和客户开 Teams 会议，大家都开着摄像头。主持人点到你了。用一两句话打招呼，说出名字和公司。对方说：好，下一位是谁？
example: Hi, that's me. I'm {name} from {company}. Good to see you all.

words.en: put a face to the name

task: You walk into a client's meeting room with your colleague Mike. Someone you haven't met asks who you are. Answer in one or two sentences.
say: Sorry, and you are?
zh: 你和同事 Mike 一起走进客户的会议室。一位你没见过的人问你是谁。用一两句话回答。对方说：不好意思，请问你是？
example: Oh, sorry, I'm {name} from {company}. I'm here with Mike for the kick-off.

words.en: we're here for the ten o'clock
words.zh: 我们是来开十点的会的

task: Today you're at a client meeting only to listen and take notes. Introduce yourself in one or two sentences and say why you're there.
say: I don't think we've met yet.
zh: 今天你参加客户会议只是旁听和做笔记。用一两句话介绍自己，并说明你为什么在场。对方说：我们好像还没见过。
example: Hi, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'm mainly here to listen and take notes today.

task: Round-the-table intros at a client meeting. Give your name, role and company, then hand over to Sarah, who's sitting next to you.
say: Do you want to kick us off?
zh: 客户会议上轮流做介绍。说出名字、职位和公司，然后交给坐在你旁边的 Sarah。对方说：你先来开个头吧？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Over to you, Sarah.

task: A client didn't catch your name at the start of the meeting. Say it again clearly with your company, and stay relaxed.
say: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
zh: 会议开始时客户没听清你的名字。放松地、清楚地再说一遍名字和公司。对方说：不好意思，我没听清你的名字。
example: No worries. It's {name}, from {company}.

words.en: it's a bit of a mouthful

task: A big client meeting with twenty people. The chair asks for name and company only. Keep it very short.
say: We've got a big group, so just your name and company, please.
zh: 一个有二十人参加的大型客户会议。主持人只要求说名字和公司。尽量简短。对方说：人比较多，请只说名字和公司。
example: Hi, {name} from {company}. Thanks for having us.

task: You've just joined a client's Teams call with your camera off because your internet is slow. The host notices your name. Introduce yourself and explain the camera briefly.
say: Someone's just joined. Who's that?
zh: 你刚加入客户的 Teams 会议，因为网速慢没开摄像头。主持人注意到了你的名字。介绍自己，并简单解释一下摄像头的事。对方说：有人刚进来，是谁呀？
example: Hi, it's {name} from {company}. Sorry, my camera's off. My internet's a bit slow today, but I can hear you fine.

task: Your manager, Raj, introduces you to a client. You'll be doing the testing on their new HR system. Thank Raj, say hello and say what you'll do.
say: And this is the newest member of our team, who'll be helping on your project.
zh: 你的经理 Raj 把你介绍给客户。你将负责客户新 HR 系统的测试。感谢 Raj，打个招呼，并说说你要做什么。对方说：这位是我们团队的新成员，会参与你们的项目。
example: Thanks, Raj. Hi everyone, I'm {name}. I'll be doing the testing on your new HR system, so you'll be seeing quite a bit of me.

words.en: looking forward to working with you
make sure it works as expected

task: A project kick-off with the client. On this project you'll look after the data migration. Give your name, role, company and what you'll do, in about 20 seconds.
say: Could you all introduce yourselves and say what you'll be doing on the project?
zh: 和客户的项目启动会。你在这个项目里负责数据迁移。用大约 20 秒说出名字、职位、公司和你要做的事。对方说：请大家介绍一下自己，并说说你在项目里负责什么。
example: Hi all, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. On this project I'll be looking after the data migration, moving everything from the old system to the new one. Really looking forward to it.

task: You're at a client workshop on security. The facilitator asks for your name and what you hope to get from today. You want to understand how the client manages user access now.
say: Let's start with names and what you're hoping to get out of today.
zh: 你参加客户的安全研讨会。主持人请大家说名字和今天想收获什么。你想了解客户目前是怎样管理用户权限的。对方说：我们先从名字开始，再说说你今天希望有什么收获。
example: Hi, I'm {name} from {company}. I'm hoping to get a clear picture of how you manage user access at the moment, so we know where to start.

task: A weekly status meeting on the client's cloud migration. Two new people from the client have joined. You run these updates. Welcome them and introduce yourself.
say: We've got a couple of new faces today, so let's do a quick round.
zh: 客户云迁移项目的每周进度会。客户方来了两位新同事。这个会由你主持。欢迎他们并介绍自己。对方说：今天有几位新面孔，我们快速介绍一轮吧。
example: Welcome, both of you. I'm {name} from {company}. I run these weekly updates on the cloud migration, so if anything doesn't make sense, just ask me.

words.en: glad to have you on board

task: A video call with a client team in Australia. It's morning for them and afternoon for you. You're joining from your company's Wellington office. Introduce yourself.
say: Okay, let's do intros. Who's joining from New Zealand?
zh: 和澳大利亚的客户团队开视频会议。他们那边是上午，你这边是下午。你在公司的惠灵顿办公室参会。介绍自己。对方说：好，我们来做个介绍。谁是从新西兰参会的？
example: That's me. Good morning to you, and good afternoon from us. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, joining from our Wellington office.

words.zh: 希望咖啡已经起作用了

task: Your account manager, Sarah, hands over to you. You'll be the client's technical contact for their managed service. Thank her and introduce yourself.
say: And I'll let our technical person introduce themselves.
zh: 你们的客户经理 Sarah 把话交给你。你将是客户托管服务的技术联系人。感谢她，然后介绍自己。对方说：接下来请我们的技术同事自我介绍一下。
example: Thanks, Sarah. Hi, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be your technical contact for the managed service, so if you've got any tech questions, I'm your person.

task: This week you joined the team working on the client's Microsoft 365 rollout. It's your first time at their weekly meeting. Introduce yourself and say you're still catching up.
say: Oh, we've got someone new today!
zh: 你这周刚加入客户 Microsoft 365 部署项目的团队。这是你第一次参加他们的周会。介绍自己，并说明你还在熟悉情况。对方说：哦，今天来了个新人！
example: Yes, hi, I'm {name}. I joined the Microsoft 365 rollout team this week, so I'm still catching up, but it's really good to meet you all.

task: Quick intros at a client meeting. You'll be building the client's new sales reports over the next few weeks. Introduce yourself, then hand over to Aroha.
say: Who wants to go next?
zh: 客户会议上快速做介绍。接下来几周你将为客户制作新的销售报表。介绍自己，然后把话交给 Aroha。对方说：下一个谁来？
example: I'll go. Hi, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be building your new sales reports over the next few weeks. Okay, that's me. Aroha, over to you.

task: In-person project kick-off, about 30 seconds. You're the technical lead for the client's new reporting dashboard. Their big goal is to stop using monthly spreadsheets. You'll meet their finance team every week. Link your intro to their goal.
say: Let's go round and hear from everyone.
zh: 面对面的项目启动会，大约 30 秒。你是客户新报表仪表盘的技术负责人。他们的主要目标是不再用每月的电子表格。你每周会和他们的财务团队开会。把你的介绍和他们的目标联系起来。对方说：我们轮一圈，听听每个人的介绍。
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be the technical lead on your new reporting dashboard. I know the big goal is getting rid of those monthly spreadsheets, so that's my focus too. I'll catch up with the finance team every week, so you'll see plenty of me.

task: A first discovery call with a logistics company. They're thinking about moving their servers to the cloud. You're the technical person from your company. Introduce yourself and say you're mainly there to listen and understand their setup.
say: Thanks for making time. Maybe you could start by introducing yourselves?
zh: 和一家物流公司的第一次需求了解电话会。他们在考虑把服务器迁到云上。你是公司这边的技术人员。介绍自己，并说明你主要是来听、了解他们现在的环境。对方说：谢谢你们抽时间。要不你们先介绍一下自己？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, the technical person on our side today. Mostly I'm here to listen and understand how your servers are set up now, so we can work out whether the cloud makes sense for you.

task: Your colleague Raj is on parental leave for three months, and you're covering his client while he's away. Introduce yourself at your first meeting with them and reassure them.
say: So you're covering for Raj?
zh: 同事 Raj 休三个月的育儿假，他不在期间由你负责他的客户。在和客户的第一次会议上介绍自己，让他们放心。对方说：所以你是来替 Raj 的？
example: That's right. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Raj is on parental leave for three months, so I'll be your main point of contact until he's back. He's given me a full handover, so nothing should fall through the cracks.

words.en: pick up where he left off

task: A Teams kick-off for a security review of the client's network. You'll do the review over the next month. Your background is in networking, about eight years. Introduce yourself in about 30 seconds.
say: Could you tell us a bit about yourself?
zh: 客户网络安全评估项目的 Teams 启动会。接下来一个月由你做评估。你的背景是网络，大约八年。用大约 30 秒介绍自己。对方说：能介绍一下你自己吗？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be doing the security review of your network over the next month. My background's in networking. I've been doing that for about eight years, so this is right up my street.

task: You're co-running a client workshop. Raj runs the first half. After morning tea you'll run the session on the client's data and reporting needs. Open with a welcome and introduce yourself.
say: Okay, looks like everyone's here. Do you want to start?
zh: 你和同事一起主持客户研讨会。前半场由 Raj 负责，茶歇之后你负责关于客户数据和报表需求的环节。先欢迎大家，再介绍自己。对方说：好，大家好像都到了。你来开始吧？
example: Kia ora and welcome, everyone. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Raj will take the first half, and after morning tea I'll run the session on your data and reporting needs. Please jump in with questions any time.

task: A status meeting. Three people from the client's finance team are joining for the first time. On this project you connect the new system to their finance software. Introduce yourself and say why it matters to them.
say: Before we start, can the project team introduce themselves for our finance colleagues?
zh: 项目进度会。客户财务部的三个人第一次参加。你在项目里负责把新系统和他们的财务软件对接起来。介绍自己，并说明这件事和他们有什么关系。对方说：开始之前，项目组能不能先给财务部的同事介绍一下自己？
example: Of course. Hi, I'm {name} from {company}. I'm connecting the new system to your finance software. So basically, I make sure the numbers flow through to you correctly. You'll probably hear from me when we start testing.

task: You're at a client's office to train staff on their new booking system. The office manager introduces you. Say hello, introduce yourself and help the staff relax. You'll be around all week.
say: Okay, everyone, this is the person who'll be showing us the new system.
zh: 你到客户办公室培训员工使用新的预约系统。办公室经理介绍了你。打个招呼，介绍自己，让大家放松。这一整周你都会在。对方说：好，各位，这位会给我们演示新系统。
example: Thanks! Morning, everyone. I'm {name} from {company}. I'll be showing you the new booking system today. We'll take it step by step, and I'll be around all week if you get stuck.

words.en: no such thing as a silly question

task: Onboarding meeting with a new managed services client. You'll run their monthly service reviews. For urgent problems they should call the 24/7 support desk, not you. Introduce yourself and explain this.
say: So who will we be dealing with from now on?
zh: 和一个新的托管服务客户开入职会议。你负责每月的服务回顾会。紧急问题他们应该打 24 小时支持热线，而不是找你。介绍自己并说明这一点。对方说：那以后我们主要跟谁打交道？
example: That'll be me. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'll run your monthly service reviews. For anything urgent, though, please call the support desk. They're there 24/7, and they'll get to it faster than I can.

task: You arrive five minutes late to a client kick-off because of traffic. You'll be doing the testing on this project. Apologise briefly, introduce yourself and let them carry on.
say: Ah, here's our last person. Do you want to introduce yourself?
zh: 你因为堵车，客户启动会迟到了五分钟。你在项目里负责测试。简短道歉，介绍自己，然后请大家继续。对方说：啊，最后一位到了。你要不要介绍一下自己？
example: Sorry I'm late, everyone, the traffic was terrible. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be looking after the testing on this project. Please carry on, I'll catch up.

words.en: don't let me hold you up

task: A kick-off for the client's new data platform. You'll build the platform. You work closely with Aroha, your project manager. Introduce yourself and explain how you and Aroha split the work.
say: Can the team from your side introduce themselves?
zh: 客户新数据平台的启动会。你负责搭建平台，并和项目经理 Aroha 紧密合作。介绍自己，并说明你和 Aroha 怎么分工。对方说：你们那边的团队能介绍一下吗？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be building the data platform, and I work closely with Aroha, our project manager. She keeps everything on track, and I look after the technical side.

task: A project kick-off, about 45 seconds. You'll lead the move of the client's 40 servers to the cloud over three months. You've worked with Azure for about five years. Add one personal touch: where you're from.
say: Let's hear a bit more from each of you.
zh: 项目启动会，大约 45 秒。你将在三个月内带领把客户的 40 台服务器迁到云上。你用 Azure 大约五年了。加一点个人信息：你来自哪里。对方说：我们请每位多讲一点。
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be leading the move of your 40 servers to the cloud over the next three months. I've been working with Azure for about five years, so I've done a few of these. On a personal note, I'm originally from {hometown}. Really looking forward to working with you all.

task: A pre-sales discovery call. Your account manager, Sarah, is sick, so you have to lead. Introduce yourself, give Sarah's apologies and set up the call: first hear about their setup and goals, then share ideas.
say: Hi, thanks for joining. Is Sarah coming?
zh: 售前需求了解会。客户经理 Sarah 病了，所以由你主持。介绍自己，替 Sarah 致歉，并说明会议安排：先听他们的现状和目标，再分享想法。对方说：你好，谢谢参加。Sarah 会来吗？
example: Thanks for having us. Unfortunately Sarah's unwell today, so I'll be leading the call. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. The plan is to hear about your current setup and goals first, then share a few ideas. Does that work for you?

task: The client's CFO joins your project status meeting for the first time. You're building automatic month-end reports. Right now their team spends three days doing them by hand. Introduce yourself in plain language and say how it will help finance.
say: This is my first one of these. Can someone tell me who's who?
zh: 客户的财务总监第一次参加项目进度会。你在做自动生成的月末报表。目前他们团队要花三天手工做。用通俗的话介绍自己，并说明这对财务部有什么帮助。对方说：我第一次参加这个会。谁能告诉我各位都是谁？
example: Of course. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm building the automatic month-end reports. Right now your team spends about three days pulling those together by hand. Once this is live, they'll be ready on the first morning of the month.

words.en: at the click of a button

task: You're opening a two-hour workshop for the client's support staff on their new ticketing system. Introduce yourself, say how long it'll take and ask them to interrupt with questions.
say: Over to you.
zh: 你要为客户的支持人员开一个两小时的新工单系统培训。介绍自己，说明需要多长时间，并请大家随时提问。对方说：交给你了。
example: Thanks, and morning, everyone. I'm {name} from {company}. Over the next two hours I'll walk you through the new ticketing system. This works best as a conversation, so please stop me any time with questions. There's no such thing as a silly one.

task: A Teams call with 30 client staff before their new payroll system goes live. You're the go-live support lead. Introduce yourself and tell them how to reach you: post in the project Teams channel.
say: And who should people contact if something goes wrong on the day?
zh: 新薪资系统上线前，和 30 位客户员工开 Teams 会议。你是上线支持负责人。介绍自己，并告诉他们怎么联系你：在项目的 Teams 频道里发消息。对方说：如果上线当天出了问题，大家应该找谁？
example: That's me. Hi everyone, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm leading support for the payroll go-live. If something goes wrong, post it in the project Teams channel. My team and I will be watching it all day, and we'll jump on it quickly.

words.en: the best way to reach me

task: A kick-off with a primary school's office staff. They're not technical. You'll set up their new laptops and email. Introduce yourself with no jargon and put them at ease.
say: We're not very techy here, I'm afraid!
zh: 和一所小学的行政人员开启动会。他们不懂技术。你将为他们配置新笔记本电脑和邮箱。不用专业术语介绍自己，让他们放心。对方说：不好意思，我们这儿的人都不太懂技术！
example: That's totally fine, that's what I'm here for. I'm {name} from {company}. I'll be setting up your new laptops and email. I'll keep it simple, and I'll make sure everyone's comfortable before I leave.

task: In-person kick-off. Earlier the client said their biggest worry is downtime during the migration. Keeping downtime low is your job, and each cutover will happen after hours. Introduce yourself and link it to their worry.
say: Okay, and last but not least?
zh: 面对面的启动会。客户刚才说他们最担心迁移期间系统停机。减少停机正是你的工作，每次切换都会安排在下班后。介绍自己，并和他们的担心联系起来。对方说：好，最后一位？
example: Hi, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Earlier you mentioned downtime is the big worry. That's actually my job on this project. I'll plan each cutover for after hours, and you'll know exactly when it's happening and what to expect.

task: Kick-off for a two-week security review. Some client staff look nervous. Introduce yourself, say what you'll do, and reassure them it's not about blaming anyone.
say: Maybe you could explain what you'll be doing?
zh: 为期两周的安全评估启动会。有些客户员工看起来很紧张。介绍自己，说明你要做什么，并让他们放心这不是为了追究谁的责任。对方说：你能不能讲讲你要做些什么？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Over the next two weeks I'll be reviewing your security setup. Just to be clear, this isn't about catching anyone out. It's about finding the gaps before someone else does. I'll be chatting with a few of you, so thanks in advance.

task: A steering committee with senior client managers. You're the delivery lead for their new data warehouse, and you'll present progress every month. Give a crisp 20-second intro.
say: For the benefit of the committee, could you introduce yourself?
zh: 和客户高层的指导委员会会议。你是他们新数据仓库的交付负责人，每月会来汇报进度。做一个干脆的 20 秒介绍。对方说：为了让委员会了解，请你介绍一下自己。
example: Of course. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm the delivery lead for your new data warehouse. I'll present progress here every month: where we're at, any risks, and what we need from you.

task: Your colleague Raj over-hypes you to the client. Thank him with humour, bring it back down to earth, and introduce yourself. You've spent six years on cloud migrations.
say: And this is our cloud genius. Honestly, there's nothing they don't know.
zh: 同事 Raj 在客户面前把你夸得太过了。幽默地感谢他，把话拉回现实，再介绍自己。你做云迁移已经六年了。对方说：这位是我们的云计算天才。说真的，没有他不懂的。
example: Ha, thanks Raj, that's very generous! I definitely don't know everything, but I have spent the last six years on cloud migrations. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm really looking forward to working on yours.

words.en: don't believe a word of it

task: A tense meeting. The client's systems were down for four hours yesterday, and the client manager is angry. You're leading the investigation. Introduce yourself calmly, acknowledge the problem and say what happens next.
say: Before we start, who's actually responsible for fixing this?
zh: 气氛紧张的会议。客户的系统昨天宕机了四个小时，客户经理很生气。你负责调查原因。冷静地介绍自己，承认问题，并说明接下来怎么做。对方说：开始之前，到底是谁负责解决这个问题？
example: That's me. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm leading the investigation into yesterday's outage. First, I'm sorry for the disruption. Four hours is a long time. I'll walk you through what we know so far, and what we're doing to stop it happening again.

words.en: make sure it doesn't happen again
get to the bottom of it

task: The client's manager calls you by the wrong name in front of everyone. Correct it in a light, friendly way, then introduce yourself. You'll be doing their network upgrade.
say: Thanks for coming, Ray. Do you want to tell everyone what you'll be doing?
zh: 客户经理当着大家的面叫错了你的名字。轻松友好地纠正，然后介绍自己。你将负责他们的网络升级。对方说：谢谢你过来，Ray。你给大家讲讲你要做什么吧？
example: Happy to. Just quickly, it's actually {name}, but don't worry, it happens all the time! I'm from {company}, and I'll be doing your network upgrade. I'll go through the plan in a minute.

words.zh: 没关系，没造成什么影响

task: Your manager, Mike, introduces you to the client as the project manager, but you're actually on the development side and will build the integration. Aroha is the project manager and joins next week. Correct it politely.
say: And this is our project manager, who'll keep everything on schedule.
zh: 经理 Mike 向客户介绍你时说你是项目经理，但你其实是开发人员，负责做系统集成。项目经理是 Aroha，她下周加入。礼貌地纠正。对方说：这位是我们的项目经理，会确保一切按计划进行。
example: Thanks, Mike. Just a small correction, I'm actually on the development side. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'll be building the integration. Aroha's our project manager, and she'll be joining us next week.

words.en: the one to talk to about
I wish I were that organised

task: You're the new lead on a client project that ran late under the previous team. The client asks if things will be different. Introduce yourself, be honest, and say what you'll change: a weekly update and a clear plan by Friday.
say: So, are things going to be different this time?
zh: 你是一个客户项目的新负责人，之前的团队让项目延期了。客户问这次会不会不一样。介绍自己，坦诚一点，并说明你会做出的改变：每周更新，周五前给出清晰的计划。对方说：那这次会不一样吗？
example: That's a fair question. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'm the new lead on this project. I know it's run late, and I'm sorry about that. From now on you'll get a weekly update from me, and I'll have a clear plan to you by Friday.

task: You're the only person joining a hybrid client meeting online. Everyone in the room forgot about you, and at the end the chair remembers. Introduce yourself with good humour. You'll be looking after the client's cloud costs.
say: Oh, and we've got someone online too! Sorry, we forgot about you.
zh: 一个线上线下混合的客户会议，只有你一个人在线上。会议室里的人都把你忘了，快结束时主持人才想起来。幽默地介绍自己。你负责客户的云成本管理。对方说：哦，线上还有一位！不好意思，把你忘了。
example: Ha, no worries, I'm still here! I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be looking after your cloud costs on this project. I'll keep my camera on, so you don't forget me next time.

words.en: out of sight, out of mind

task: You're taking over a client from your colleague Mike, who the client loved. He's moving to another team. Acknowledge how they feel, introduce yourself, mention your two-week handover, and suggest meeting each person this month.
say: We were really sad to lose Mike. He knew everything about our setup.
zh: 你从同事 Mike 手里接手一个客户，客户非常喜欢他。他调去别的团队了。体谅客户的感受，介绍自己，提到你们做了两周的交接，并提议这个月和每个人都见一面。对方说：Mike 走了我们真的很舍不得。我们的系统他什么都知道。
example: I can understand that. Mike's been brilliant, and he's left big shoes to fill. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. We've spent the last two weeks on a detailed handover, and he's only a phone call away. I'd love to meet each of you this month to hear what matters most.

words.en: he's still a phone call away
words.zh: 他还是一个电话就能找到

task: A kick-off with a council manager who had a bad experience with another IT company. You're the delivery lead, and you've done three similar migrations for other councils. Introduce yourself and build trust without overpromising.
say: We've been burned before. Why should we trust you?
zh: 和一位地方政府的经理开启动会，他们以前和另一家 IT 公司合作得很不愉快。你是交付负责人，曾为其他地方政府做过三个类似的迁移项目。介绍自己，建立信任，但不要过度承诺。对方说：我们以前吃过亏。凭什么相信你们？
example: I completely understand, and I won't ask you to trust us straight away. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'll be leading the delivery. I've done three similar migrations for other councils. What I can promise is honesty. If something's going wrong, you'll hear it from me first.

words.en: happy to put you in touch

task: You're hosting a kick-off with the client and two other suppliers. Your company is coordinating the project. Introduce yourself, explain the plan for today (intros, timeline, who owns what), then hand over to Mike from the networking supplier.
say: Okay, it's ten o'clock. Shall we get started?
zh: 你主持一个有客户和另外两家供应商参加的启动会。你们公司负责协调整个项目。介绍自己，说明今天的安排（互相介绍、时间表、明确分工），然后交给网络供应商的 Mike。对方说：好，十点了。我们开始吧？
example: Yes, let's. Welcome, everyone. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. We're coordinating the project, so I'll be chairing these meetings. Today we'll do intros, go through the timeline and agree who owns what. Let's start with the networking team. Mike, over to you.

task: The client's chief executive gives you one minute at the kick-off. You'll lead the six-month rollout of their new finance system. You've worked on finance systems for about ten years. Say what success looks like: a smooth go-live with no disruption to payroll.
say: You've got a minute. Tell me who you are and why you're here.
zh: 在启动会上，客户的首席执行官给你一分钟。你将带领为期六个月的新财务系统上线项目。你做财务系统大约十年了。说说什么才算成功：顺利上线，不影响发工资。对方说：给你一分钟。告诉我你是谁，为什么在这里。
example: Thanks. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}, and I'll be leading the rollout of your new finance system over the next six months. I've worked on finance systems for about ten years, so I know where the risks are. For me, success is simple: a smooth go-live and no disruption to payroll.
